newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Apasco raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apasco raised to buy.

text.p: Robert Fleming Inc. said Monday it was upgrading Mexican cement maker Apasco SA to buy from hold.

"The current uncertainty surrounding the movement of cement prices in Mexico, coupled with the (company's) recent weak quarterly earnings report, has provided a buying opportunity in Apasco shares, we believe, and therefore, the investment opinion is being raised to buy at a price of 48.70 pesos per ordinary share," analyust Ben Unglow said in a report.

"Given our view that the price competition in the cement industry will be likely short-lived and that the Mexican cement industry is showing a volume recovery of five percent or more per year, and given that Apasco shares have fallen back sharply to historically attractive valuation levels, the investment opinion on the shares as being upgraded from hold to buy," he said.

"Admittedly, the outlook is uncertain in the near-term; however, we do not believe that Apasco is set to suffer a permanent de-rating as a consequence of one or even two quarters' disapponting results," he added.

"It remains a well-managed, highly cash-generative business in a growth market on currently attractive valuations that has suffered a short-term earnings set-back. In our experience, that can provide good buying opportunities," Unglow said.
